about_the_game:
As an industrial security officer, you are asked to retrieve important technical documents from a factory that was abruptly shut down about 5 years ago. You sneak into the factory to secure the documents, relying on a small flashlight in the complete darkness. Retrieve the documents deep inside the factory and safely escape the place.

Objective

Explore the dark, maze-like factory with only your flashlight while avoiding He, who roams within. Secure the documents and escape safely.

Search and Escape

Once you’ve retrieved the technical documents stored deep in the dark factory, you must quickly escape. But He won’t just sit back and watch you walk out.

Flashlight

The flashlight is your only reliable source of light in the dark factory. It will help you search through the darkness and become your only hope in this pitch-black place.

CCTV

You can monitor various parts of the factory via CCTV.

CCTV can be accessed through monitors in the control room. If power is cut off, CCTV will be unavailable.

Use CCTV to track He’s movements and avoid crossing his path.

He

He is roaming the factory with an axe. If you don’t want to fall victim to it, avoid He while you search and escape.

Always stay alert. He may suddenly rush at you from the darkness when you least expect it.

Controls

Use "WASD" to move, "Shift" to sprint, and "CTRL" to crouch.

Press "E" to interact with objects such as doors and items.

Use "F" to turn your flashlight on or off. See the flashlight section for more details.

Press "ESC" or "P" to pause the game.

Good luck!
